answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a unique physical relic, such as a tamper-evident neutron dosimeter whose irradiation history is logged in a distributed atlas of reactor signatures. Validators cross-check a pearl of provenance hash against this atlas before granting voting weight, so cloned identities fail the physical-history challenge. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
